lines.tts: Where will you be bloody born this time?
The bloody United Kingdom, the city of Birmingham.
Roughly a bloody one in two hundred chance.
About fifteen thousand bloody babies are born here every year.
Your name is Gary, but everyone calls you bloody Gaz.
Birmingham has more miles of canal than bloody Venice.
But instead of gondolas, it's mostly bloody shopping trolleys.
It calls itself the second city, and Manchester gets bloody furious about it.
Your dad's been stuck on bloody Spaghetti Junction since nineteen seventy-two.
Shift your bloody car, you fucking muppet!
At five, Gaz goes on a bloody school trip to Cadbury World.
Cadbury's been making chocolate here since bloody eighteen twenty-four.
He eats so much, he throws up on the bloody coach.
Oh, for fuck's sake, bloody Gary!
At sixteen, he buys a flat cap, because Peaky Blinders was set in bloody Birmingham.
He thinks he's Tommy Shelby, but he's just bloody Gaz.
Britain drinks about a hundred million bloody cups of tea a day.
And dinner's a balti, which was supposedly invented in bloody Birmingham.
At twenty-two, Gaz moves to bloody London.
He asks for a cob, and nobody in London knows what a bloody cob is.
Bloody fucking Londoners.
His accent keeps getting voted one of the least bloody attractive in Britain.
Someone says, you're from bloody Birmingham, aren't you?
How the fuck did you bloody know?
At thirty, he comes home and marries Sharon, who everyone calls bloody Shaz.
There's a balti, a DJ playing Black Sabbath, and about forty bloody cousins.
Because heavy metal was born in bloody Birmingham too.
People in the UK live about eighty bloody years.
Gaz grows old in bloody Birmingham.
Still stuck on bloody Spaghetti Junction.
Still saying bloody tara-a-bit.
Still eating bloody balti.
Where will you be bloody born next time?
